title.en: An Act Converting the Pototan General Hospital in the Municipality of Pototan, Province of Iloilo, into a National Hospital to be Known as Doña Trinidad Bolivar Memorial National Hospital, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting the Pototan General Hospital in the Municipality of Pototan, Province of Iloilo, into a National Hospital to be Known as Doña Trinidad Bolivar Memorial National Hospital, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Bệnh viện Đa khoa Pototan tại Đô thị Pototan, Tỉnh Iloilo thành Bệnh viện Quốc gia với tên gọi Doña Trinidad Bolivar Memorial National Hospital, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงพยาบาลทั่วไป Pototan ในเทศบาล Pototan จังหวัด Iloilo เป็น โรงพยาบาลแห่งชาติ ในชื่อ Doña Trinidad Bolivar Memorial National Hospital และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Rumah Sakit Umum Pototan di Kotamadya Pototan, Provinsi Iloilo menjadi Rumah Sakit Nasional dengan nama Doña Trinidad Bolivar Memorial National Hospital, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menukar status Hospital Besar Pototan di Perbandaran Pototan, Wilayah Iloilo kepada Hospital Kebangsaan dengan nama Doña Trinidad Bolivar Memorial National Hospital, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: The Pototan General Hospital in the Municipality of Pototan, Province of Iloilo, is hereby converted into a national hospital, to be known as Doña Trinidad Bolivar Memorial National Hospital.

The additional sum of one hundred thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the conversion, operation and maintenance of said hospital during the fiscal year nineteen hundred sixty-five. Thereafter, such sums as may be needed for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: March 26, 1965.
